# hvrg_alert_webhook (Resource)

The alert_webhook records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `rule_id` (String) the rule whose flips are delivered
- `url` (String) the http or https endpoint posted to

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) false pauses deliveries without removing the webhook
